objection.quote: - Lower bound: Liu Bang's strategy ensures at least (n+1)/(2n+1).
objection.witness: What is missing is an all-n proof that a specified Liu division guarantees at least 2^n/(2^(n+1)-1) against every legal Xiang reply and every resulting interleaving. The quoted sentence merely asserts a different bound and supplies no pairing, majorization, tree, or induction argument.
objection.load_bearing: This is the only purported lower-bound conclusion, and the write-up explicitly says the full proof remains to be completed.
